academy: SEO + High-Traffic + High-CPM Website Mastery for the AI/Zero-Click Era
governingQuestion: If Google disappeared tomorrow, why would anyone still come back to this brand?

pricing.model: Escalating ladder. Course 0 is free forever. Each subsequent course costs more than the one before, because each one unlocks higher-leverage decisions and more expensive mistakes to avoid.
pricing.note: This is a static, front-end-only demonstration site. Unlock state is stored in your own browser with IndexedDB and is NOT a security boundary. A production build must place a payment provider and server-side entitlement checks in front of paid lessons.

courses.title: Decision Economics, Risk, and Kill Criteria
courses.summary: Decide whether a site should exist before you build it: 12-month cost model, unit economics, falsifiable thesis, kill/freeze/pivot criteria, build vs buy due diligence and portfolio governance.

courses.title: Search Foundations in the AI/Zero-Click Era
courses.summary: Modern search surfaces, zero-click behaviour, crawling vs indexing vs ranking vs retrieval vs citation, search/task/return intent, topical authority plus brand demand, and trust in YMYL and AI-mediated discovery.

courses.title: Niche Research and Displacement-Adjusted Market Selection
courses.summary: High CPM is not enough. Score every niche on advertiser value minus AI-answer vulnerability, compliance burden and reviewer cost, then justify launching only three sites first.

courses.title: Owned Audience and Newsletter Product
courses.summary: Retention moved to the front of the academy. The newsletter is the product, the site is the acquisition surface: promise, lead magnet, return loops, subscriber value and newsletter-first analytics.

courses.title: Website Architecture, Cloudflare Setup, and Legal Foundations
courses.summary: Domain, DNS and email authentication, SSL/TLS Full (strict) with an origin certificate, a 12-asset URL architecture, Turnstile forms and R2 downloads, plus a counsel-facing legal question sheet and a launch gate.

courses.title: Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, and Cloudflare Ops
courses.summary: Crawlability, canonicals and redirects, Core Web Vitals with Cloudflare caching, accurate structured data, accessible forms and calculators, and a monitoring loop with product-status verification.

courses.title: Answer-Engine Visibility and Brand Demand
courses.summary: Being retrieved, summarised, cited and recommended by AI-mediated surfaces — plus the brand demand that makes you independent of any single surface. Legitimate optimisation only.

courses.title: Content Strategy, E-E-A-T, and Editorial Economics
courses.summary: Fewer, better assets. The 20/30/30/20 ratio, high-value briefs with AI-vulnerability scoring, editorial cost modelling, real reviewer recruitment, screenshot rights and refresh governance.

courses.title: On-Page SEO, CRO, and Tool/Template UX
courses.summary: On-page work that survives AI answers: titles promising something non-replaceable, guide and money-page architecture, accessible tool UX, honest internal links with ownership transparency, and conversion testing.

courses.title: APIs, Analytics, AI-Surface Measurement, and Dashboards
courses.summary: Owned-audience and brand signals as headline KPIs, Search Console and GA4 event design, Cloudflare analytics, API workflows that create tasks rather than publish, and a dashboard that forces decisions.

courses.title: Link Building, Partnerships, and Digital PR
courses.summary: Linkable assets in the AI era, digital PR with original data, partnerships and expert commentary, strictly safe outreach, and campaign falsifiability: three failures means change the thesis.

courses.title: Monetization, Compliance, and Revenue Resilience
courses.summary: Display, affiliate, lead generation and sponsorship — with a verification log instead of stale thresholds, disclosure discipline, concentration limits and a monthly monetisation governance review.

courses.title: Capstone: 3-Site Portfolio First, 10-Site Expansion Later
courses.summary: Build three sites, measure, prune, then decide whether to expand. Shared infrastructure, the 12-asset MVP, month 3/6/9 gates, the pruning scorecard and honest cross-referral rules.

phase2.name: Home Energy and Real Estate ROI
